label: Delivery
description: Defaults for how long buyers can download what they bought. A product can override them on its Digital delivery tab. Changes apply to new purchases only.

fields.label: Downloads per item
fields.description: How many times a buyer can download each file or open each link. Leave empty for unlimited.

fields.label: Access period (days)
fields.description: Days after purchase that downloads stay available. Leave empty to keep them available.
